title: Athlete memory fact
description: A user-visible fact saved from a Coach conversation for relevant future conversations and athlete-state assessments.

claim.description: The concise factual claim saved for future use.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the fact.

epistemicStatus.description: Whether the fact is model-extracted, user-confirmed, or otherwise qualified.

confidence.description: The bounded extraction confidence from zero to one.

eventStart.description: The beginning of the real-world event interval in ISO 8601 format.

eventEnd.description: The end of the real-world event interval in ISO 8601 format.

timeText.description: The original relative or absolute time expression.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used to resolve event time.

validFrom.description: The time from which the fact is applicable.

validUntil.description: The fact expiry time, when bounded.
